cohort: 136 patients that were diagnosed with Allman type I clavicle fracture
finding: Natural birth with a pelvic presentation and cesarean delivery with cranial presentation were associated with an increased risk of clavicle fracture and brachial plexus birth palsy.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery with cranial presentation increases the risk of clavicle fracture and brachial plexus birth palsy by 5.04 compared to natural birth.
birth_weight: mentioned as collected data but not reported
